column1: # Sonic Frontiers Definitive Edition (SEGA / Sonic Team, Switch 2, v65536 = 1.0.0), SDK 21.4.1 (Ounce), NVN2, Hedgehog Engine 2, CRIWARE (ADX2 sound, USM movies).
# Started from the NSP script's provisional profile; brought up on the Mac with its name and depth_mode added (README.md).
# the NUP holds the whole game as update v65536 (no base)
# not loaded, main takes nothing from them the host does not supply: subsdk0 (NintendoSDK_movie; the USM movies go through CRI Mana's own decoder)
# main sets a heap of at most the pool − 64 MB: a 9216 MB heap region
# the sdk is built for the Switch 2 (spec: Ounce): its 9 GB pool
# the NPDM declares 0 MB of system resource: IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false, as on Horizon
# 1,554 shaders in Needle (HNSHV002) containers in main, 3,626 in raw/NeedleShader.pac (a PACx 403 archive of LZ4 blocks); the game's other 1,434 archives hold none
# the game calls nvnDeviceSetDepthMode with near = 0 at boot ("depth mode near=0" in the log): the pipeline bases made offline take the main0_z vertex entries. Without the key the
# bundled archive was made for near = -w, the host refused it and the first start compiled 844 shader pairs before the first frame
# used memory for the current rewritten modules, at least the default 64 MB
